STS 501.course_name: Proseminar in Science and Technology Studies
STS 501.faculty: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies
STS 501.description: Classic work in the history, philosophy, rhetoric, and sociology of science, and the development of a unified science and technology studies. Required for all students in the STS Program. This course is co-taught. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

STS 502.course_name: Core Seminar in Science and Technology Studies
STS 502.faculty: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies
STS 502.description: Thematizes the relations of historical, philosophical, literary, rhetorical, sociological, and anthropological approaches to science and technology. Recommended pre-requisite: STS_V 501. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
